observation: Builder src/render/opticCellPresentation.js. Stone variant 4 reuses ast:geology-v5:ast_common_rock:4 (visualFactory.js:2259-2261) and the cached 'optic:body:stone:v4' material (132-160, 248-256). ROCK_SURFACE_VARIANTS[4] is the darkest, roughest row (tint [0.58,0.56,0.54], roughness 1.12, ao 0.92, normalScale 0.58; rockSurfaceLibrary.js:25) — the dullest absorber, deliberately distinct from the live prism's light (module header 6-20). Geometry is shared with the ordinary rock pool, not rebuilt: opticCellGeometry('stone') returns null (122-126) and the pool warm binds the same ast_common_rock displacement per variant (396-407; visualFactory.js:4599-4604). No inclusions, no emissive, no per-cell material split. LOD hides only tagged details (hlod.js:14-19), so stone's single body geometry is stable across levels.
decision: No construction change recommended; one intentional material over the shared rock geometry completes the five-variant set. Recommend needs follow-up: the current visual state is unverified.
next: Needs a current gameplay-scale and close capture of the darkest stone variant in a real lattice, plus measured draw cost.
